subject: Novus Inc.  service debt rectification & contract amendment request
messages:
From: ops@novus.ai
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@novus.ai
Date: 2026-10-11T09:02:00Z
Subject: Severe latency/5xx spike affecting payments

Hi Mina / Ben,

We observed a sustained spike in 5xx errors and tail latency from 08:42-09:35 UTC impacting our payment processing pipeline. Error rate peaked ~6% on write endpoints; customers reported timeouts and duplicate authorization attempts. We've attached the initial logs and a short timeline.

This is production impacting  please confirm Redwood's remediation plan and whether service credits will apply under our SLA. We're standing up an incident bridge and would like a point of contact for commercial follow-up.

--
Arjun Shah
SRE Lead | Novus Inc.
ops@novus.ai
(attachment: incident_log_10112026.txt)

From: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
To: ops@novus.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-11T09:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Severe latency/5xx spike affecting payments

Arjun  thanks for the alert and logs. We're on the bridge now.

Quick note on roles: Ben will lead technical triage with your SREs, Sergio (TAM) will coordinate post-incident actions, and Aditya will handle commercial and credit questions. We'll provide an incident timeline and a proposed credit calculation within 48 hours.

Joining the bridge: https://redwood.zoom.us/incident-10112026

 Mina Haddad
Senior Manager, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: ops@novus.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-11T09:38:00Z
Subject: Re: Severe latency/5xx spike affecting payments

On bridge: initial observation is an emergent cache eviction storm combined with a metadata DB retry pattern that surfaced under a traffic surge (08:30-09:10 UTC). We're applying a targeted cache ttl increase and throttling back heavy backfill jobs.

Immediate mitigation status: 1) cache TTL bumped, 2) backfills paused, 3) flow control enabled on write path. Error rate trending down to ~0.6% as of 09:30 UTC. Leaving the bridge open for coordination.

I'll follow up with a short RCA and a mitigation runbook draft.

--
Ben Carter
Principal CS Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: procurement@novus.ai, ceo@novus.ai, legal@novus.ai
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-11T12:05:00Z
Subject: Redwood proposed credit estimate for incident 2026-10-11

Kiran / Elena / Samir  following the incident, attached is our preliminary SLA credit workbook and a proposed credit band tied to duration/impact buckets. The workbook shows conservative calculations based on the contract's 99.9% availability clause and observed error/latency windows.

We propose: 
- Operational credit: one month pro-rated credit applied to the billing period overlapping the incident (calculation in sheet 'ops_credit').
- Conditional one-time service credit: additional remediation credit subject to a short-term amendment clarifying failover windows.

Please review; Laura (legal ops) is cc'd to draft amendment language if you agree with the terms. Happy to walk through numbers on a call.

(attachment: sla_credit_calc_20261011.xlsx)

 Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: ops@novus.ai
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@novus.ai, legal@novus.ai
Date: 2026-10-12T08:16:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood proposed credit estimate for incident 2026-10-11

Thanks Aditya  we appreciate the quick calc. Two asks from Novus: 1) can Redwood provide more detail on the traffic pattern that triggered the cache evictions (we need it for our audit), and 2) Novus Procurement requests the credit applied as an invoice reduction rather than a future credit. Also looping in our CEO given customer impact.

Would like a joint legal call to finalize an amendment that includes a short-term remediation SLA and an explicit invoice adjustment. Availability: Tue 10/13 16:00 ET or Wed 10/14 09:00 ET.

--
Kiran Patel
Procurement Manager | Novus Inc.

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: legal@novus.ai, procurement@novus.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-13T16:00:00Z
Subject: Re: joint legal call to finalize amendment + invoice adjustment

Hi Samir / Kiran  thanks for the proposed times. We can do Tue 10/13 16:00 ET (joining now). Attached is a draft contract addendum that: 1) documents the incident window, 2) defines the one-time invoice reduction approach (amount in the attached calc), and 3) adds a 60-day operational remediation plan with measurable checkpoints.

Note: Redwood legal prefers an invoice adjustment for the impacted billing cycle (not a future credit) for clarity; we've reflected that in the draft. If Novus requires different accounting treatment, let's call that out in redlines.

(attachment: draft_amendment_novus_20261011.docx)

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

From: ceo@novus.ai
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@novus.ai, procurement@novus.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-14T17:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Novus  contract amendment and invoice adjustment

Team  thank you for the responsiveness. The customer impact here was material and we appreciate the invoice adjustment approach. Before signing any amendment, Novus would like: 1) a short technical appendix describing persistent mitigations (cache tuning, guardrails for backfills), 2) a firm timeline for the 60-day remediation checkpoints, and 3) a senior exec commitment for operational escalation routing.

If Redwood can include those three items in the amendment, Novus will sign and process the invoice adjustment this week. Happy to join a call tomorrow if needed.

Best,
Elena Ortiz
CEO | Novus Inc.
